title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).


The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.


The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.


Financial


● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions


Operational


● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.


Experience and Skills


● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Bilingual Receptionist
description:
Company Description


CatalyzeX is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective, highly efficient labor solutions for businesses across various industries. We help companies grow by delivering top-tier talent and support.


Role Description


We are seeking a highly professional and empathetic Paralegal Receptionist  to support a legal team remotely. The ideal candidate will be fluent in Spanish and English , with Portuguese as a strong preference , and will serve as the first point of contact for clients, ensuring a smooth intake and client communication experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer and route high volumes of incoming calls in Spanish and English with professionalism and empathy
  • Take detailed messages and leave accurate notes for attorney/client callbacks
  • Manage front desk operations, including greeting walk-ins and handling inquiries

title: Neurologista
description:
VAGA PARA MÉDICO(A) NEUROLOGISTA — INSTITUTO DO SONO


O Instituto do Sono está em busca de médico(a) neurologista com RQE ativo, para atuação em consultas por telemedicina.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil humanizado, boa comunicação e experiência para atendimento em diversas áreas da neurologia, incluindo:


* Distúrbios do sono (insônia, apneia, sonolência excessiva, parassonias etc.)  

* Cefaleias e enxaquecas  

* Tonturas e vertigens  

* Tremores e investigação de Parkinson  

* Epilepsia e convulsões  

* Pós-AVC / acompanhamento neurológico  

* Dormências, formigamentos e neuropatias  

* Déficit de memória / investigação cognitiva  

* Outros sintomas e doenças neurológicas  


Modelo de atuação:  

* Consultas 100% online (telemedicina)  

* Atuação como profissional autônomo / sem vínculo empregatício  

* Agenda flexível, conforme disponibilidade do médico  

* A clínica realiza toda a captação de pacientes, marketing, atendimento comercial e agendamento  

* Divulgação da foto, mini currículo e perfil profissional no site oficial e redes do Instituto do Sono  

* Suporte completo de secretária/comercial  


Remuneração:  

* Repasse de R$ 300,00 por consulta realizada


Requisitos obrigatórios:  

* CRM ativo  

* Especialização/residência em Neurologia  

* RQE ativo e indispensável  

* Experiência com telemedicina será um diferencial  

* Boa comunicação e postura profissional no atendimento online

Suporte administrativo dedicado ao pós-venda

CRM e automações em expansão

Pagamento conforme recebimento da taxa de adesão, com adiantamento mediante caixa

Campanhas recorrentes com bônus adicionais não mensurados nos percentuais acima


Crescimento

Operação em ampliação. Posições de liderança abrem conforme escala, para quem reúne performance + perfil de gestão. Não é automático.


Para quem é

Você vende consórcio faz tempo, tem relacionamentos vivos e fecha sem depender de lead distribuído. Quer liberdade operacional e remuneração proporcional, e assume responsabilidade pelo próprio resultado.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
A Speak in English é uma escola focada em comunicação real.


Acreditamos que aprender inglês não deve ser um processo engessado ou baseado apenas em teoria. Nosso foco é prática, clareza e confiança, preparando alunos para se expressarem com naturalidade no dia a dia, no trabalho e em viagens.


Estamos construindo um ambiente com professores que compartilham esse mesmo pensamento: ensinar de forma leve, direta e com foco em resultado.


Se você se identifica com essa proposta e acredita em um ensino mais prático e humano, queremos te conhecer.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT.


O que você vai fazer?


Ministrar aulas individuais online para alunos de diferentes idades

Desenvolver e adaptar planos de aula de acordo com o nível e objetivo do aluno

Conduzir aulas com foco em comunicação e prática


O que buscamos?


• Didática clara, carisma e paciência

• Nível avançado de inglês (C2)

• Experiência com aulas online

• Boa comunicação e organização

• Disponibilidade de horários (principalmente tarde/noite)

• Estrutura adequada para aulas online (internet, ambiente, microfone, etc.)


O que oferecemos?


Oferecemos capacitação contínua com foco em prática e comunicação real, além de suporte pedagógico para evolução constante. Você terá acesso a materiais e recursos que facilitam o planejamento das aulas, atuando em um ambiente colaborativo com professores alinhados ao mesmo propósito. Também há oportunidade de crescimento dentro do projeto e participação no processo de captação de alunos.


O diferencial?


Aqui, você não é apenas um professor.


Você faz parte de um projeto que valoriza autonomia, crescimento

e um ensino mais direto, leve e conectado com a vida real.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Company Description

K-Books is a U.S.-based accounting firm that provides financial consulting services to small businesses, ensuring clients have the clarity and insights needed to make informed business decisions.


We offer a wide range of services, from basic bookkeeping and financial reviews to training clients on best practices for bookkeeping processes and procedures. Our services also include analysis and optimization of insurance plans, retirement plans, and employee benefits, as well as budgeting, financial projections, tax strategy, and overall financial planning.


Role Description

We are seeking a dedicated Junior to Intermediate Bookkeeper for a full-time remote position. Key responsibilities include:


  • Maintaining accurate financial records
  • Transaction categorization and data accuracy
  • Bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Supporting the month-end close process


Requirements

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Based in Brazil
  • Previous experience living, studying, or working abroad
  • Experience in financial routines (AP/AR, transaction categorization, reconciliations, month-end)
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred


Profile We’re Looking For

  • Proactive and self-driven
  • Fast learner and problem-solver
  • Comfortable working in an international environment
  • Strong sense of responsibility and ownership


What we offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience (contractor – PJ/MEI)
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Potential travel allowance for international trips (once per year)
  • Exposure to international clients and work environment


100% Remote | Brazil-based only

Interested? Apply via LinkedIn.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Company Description

Vancouver Institute, a prestigious educational institution, excels in English language teaching, offering high-quality, immersive learning experiences to help students achieve fluency and confidence in English. 


With 17 years of experience and over 5,000 students taught, it now provides online English Immersion in a virtual format for young and adult learners. 


Role Description

The Institute is currently seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic English teacher for a fully remote role. Responsibilities include delivering engaging English lessons, preparing customized lesson plans, and supporting adult students in achieving their language goals.


Teachers will teach English according to each level and assess student progress, provide constructive feedback, and encourage interactivity in online classrooms via Google Meet.


Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong expertise in English teaching for any student level (A1 to C2) and online teaching approaches;
  • Experience in lesson planning tailored to diverse learning styles;
  • Proficient communication skills and the ability to engage students effectively in a virtual setting;
  • Virtual instruction experience or immersion programs is advantageous;
  • TEFL, TESOL, CELTA, or equivalent certifications are desirable;
  • A degree in Education, Letters, Linguistics, or related fields has weight;
  • A passion for teaching and creating a positive e-learning atmosphere is crucial, along with familiarity with online teaching tools.


Availability

Availability is required from Monday to Friday for at least one full shift during mornings, afternoons, or evenings. This is a temporary position starting in June, with the possibility of contract renewal.


Contact 

Please send your resume to:

title: Gerente de desenvolvimento de negócios
description:
Como Business Development Manager (Enterprise), você será responsável por construir e manter relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos e negociar contratos complexos. Também irá colaborar com times internos como parceiros de canal, especialistas de produto, executivos de contas, gerentes de contas e engenheiros de solução para garantir a satisfação do cliente.


Você é orientado ao cliente, criativo e tem perfil “hunter”? Gosta de identificar necessidades de negócio e criar soluções para grandes empresas? Então essa vaga é para você.


Responsabilidades:

• Construir e gerenciar um pipeline robusto de oportunidades qualificadas

• Conduzir etapas iniciais de descoberta e qualificação de novos negócios

• Criar relacionamento com executivos (C-level) e posicionar a Atlassian como parceira estratégica no Brasil

• Desenvolver e executar estratégias de vendas

• Entender necessidades do cliente e propor soluções

• Trabalhar com times internos (marketing, produto, canais, sucesso do cliente)

• Acompanhar tendências de mercado e concorrência


Observação:

Você não será responsável direto por preço, descontos ou contratos — isso é feito por outros times da empresa


Requisitos:

• 8+ anos em vendas enterprise de software / desenvolvimento de negócios

• Experiência com grandes contas na América Latina

• Experiência com executivos C-level

• Experiência em tecnologia (preferencialmente IA)

• Inglês e português fluentes

• Capacidade de alinhar times internos

• Experiência com CRM e métricas de vendas

• Perfil consultivo para identificar oportunidades

• Forte habilidade de relacionamento e atuação cross-funcional

title: Coordenador de Banco de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.
  • Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança.
  • Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;


Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados .
  • Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente.
  • Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance.
  • Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação.
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Experiencia em gestão de pessoas
  • Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs
  • Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI
  • Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server
  • Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável)
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável)
  • Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dados


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda a Sexta

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

title: Instrutor de Idiomas
description:
Descrição:

Instrutor de inglês - turno tarde e noite

Tem inglês fluente e quer ajudar mais pessoas a se tornarem bilíngues? Vem com a gente!


Responsabilidades:

Preparar e ministrar aula de inglês, conforme a metodologia, para todos os níveis e públicos atendidos na escola;

Preencher e atualizar documentos pedagógicos de seus alunos;

Avaliar e fornecer feedback constante sobre o aprendizado dos alunos.


Qualificações:

Nível avançado de inglês - B2 ou C1

Estar cursando letras inglês é um diferencial

Morar em Canoas ou Cachoeirinha - RS

title: PROFESSOR AUXILIAR DE INGLÊS CORPORATIVO ONLINE - HOME OFFICE
description:
PROFESSOR AUXILIAR DE INGLÊS CORPORATIVO ONLINE - HOME OFFICE


LEIA COM ATENÇÃO:

NÃO SE CANDIDATE CASO NÃO POSSUA EXPERIÊNCIA COM ENSINO DE INGLÊS CORPORATIVO. CANDIDATURAS FORA DO PERFIL SERÃO DESCARTADAS


Estamos em busca dos melhores professores de inglês corporativo, dedicados e comprometidos, que desejam contribuir para o desenvolvimento de carreira dos nossos alunos. Oferecemos remuneração acima do mercado, estabilidade e plano de carreira. Vaga perfeita para professores que buscam crescimento profissional.


Função:

  • Auxiliar o professor principal na ministração de aulas online;
  • Auxiliar na aplicação e correção de provas e assignments;
  • Colaborar na elaboração e correção de materiais didáticos;
  • Oferecer suporte no feedback aos alunos;
  • Substituir professores regulares se necessário;


Pré-requisitos:

  • Possuir notebook, iluminação adequada, internet estável e local apropriado para lecionar;
  • Inglês \"fluente\" ou \"nativo\", com sólido conhecimento de vocabulário e expressões empresariais;
  • Experiência no ensino de língua inglesa para adultos;
  • Pontualidade, proatividade, colaboração, organização, boa comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.


Indispensável:

  • Experiência internacional em país de língua inglesa;
  • Formação superior nas áreas de Business;
  • Disponibilidade para turmas aos sábados pela manhã;


*Não serão aceitas candidaturas fora do perfil desejável.


Carga horária:  4 horas/aula diárias.


Modelo de contratação e benefícios

A contratação inicia-se no cargo de Professor Auxiliar, com um período de adaptação de aproximadamente 2 a 3 meses, durante o qual será avaliada a adequação do professor à metodologia da escola e aos padrões pedagógicos adotados.


Após esse período, havendo bom desempenho e alinhamento metodológico, o professor poderá ser efetivado como Professor Oficial. A partir da efetivação, o profissional passa a ter direito ao benefício de plano de saúde, além das demais condições previstas no plano de carreira.

Oferecemos remuneração acima do mercado, estabilidade e plano de carreira. Vaga perfeita para professores que buscam crescimento profissional.


Função:

  • Auxiliar o professor principal na ministração de aulas online;
  • Auxiliar na aplicação e correção de provas e assignments;
  • Colaborar na elaboração e correção de materiais didáticos;
  • Oferecer suporte no feedback aos alunos;
  • Substituir professores regulares se necessário;


Pré-requisitos:

  • Possuir notebook, iluminação adequada, internet estável e local apropriado para lecionar;
  • Inglês \"fluente\" ou \"nativo\", com sólido conhecimento de vocabulário e expressões empresariais;
  • Experiência no ensino de língua inglesa para adultos;
  • Pontualidade, proatividade, colaboração, organização, boa comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.


Indispensável:

  • Experiência internacional em país de língua inglesa;
  • Formação superior nas áreas de Business;
  • Disponibilidade para turmas aos sábados pela manhã;


*Não serão aceitas candidaturas fora do perfil desejável.


Carga horária:  4 horas/aula diárias.


Modelo de contratação e benefícios

A contratação inicia-se no cargo de Professor Auxiliar, com um período de adaptação de aproximadamente 2 a 3 meses, durante o qual será avaliada a adequação do professor à metodologia da escola e aos padrões pedagógicos adotados.


Após esse período, havendo bom desempenho e alinhamento metodológico, o professor poderá ser efetivado como Professor Oficial. A partir da efetivação, o profissional passa a ter direito ao benefício de plano de saúde, além das demais condições previstas no plano de carreira.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Descrição da Empresa A nexo soluções tecnológicas é dedicada a oferecer soluções inovadoras que otimizam processos empresariais e aceleram a transformação digital. Nosso objetivo é ajudar empresas a melhorar a eficiência operacional e alcançar resultados estratégicos através da adoção de tecnologias avançadas. Com uma equipe de especialistas altamente qualificados, proporcionamos suporte personalizado e criativo. Valorizamos a inovação, colaboração e excelência em todas as etapas do trabalho.
Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um/a Analista de Processos para identificar, analisar e propor melhorias nos processos de negócios a fim de aumentar a eficiência organizacional. Suas responsabilidades incluem mapear processos, identificar gargalos, propor soluções e garantir sua implementação. Você também colaborará com diferentes equipes para entender as necessidades do negócio e transformar essas informações em ações estratégicas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e será realizado de forma remota.
Qualificações
  • Gestão de Processos: Experiência em gestão e melhoria de processos empresariais, incluindo análise e mapeamento de fluxos de trabalho.
  • Análises e Tomada de Decisões: Habilidades analíticas para identificar pontos de aperfeiçoamento e propor soluções efetivas e inovadoras.
  • Comunicação e Colaboração: Capacidade de transmitir ideias de maneira clara e eficaz, e de colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para atingir objetivos comuns.
  • Formação em administração, engenharia de produção, tecnologia da informação ou áreas afins será considerada um diferencial, assim como experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de mapeamento de processos.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
About the Role


The SAP MDG (Material Master Data) Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP MDG function for all types of master data, and its integration with S/4HANA and other applications across global enterprises. The role ensures data governance, master data quality, workflow enforcement and compliance with business rules. This key role focuses on providing technology solutions for business requirements, providing global design and localization as warranted, stabilizing and enhancing the existing solutions, resolving defects, production break-fixes, as well as providing recommendation regarding optimal business processes by leveraging SAP best practices. This person will collaborate with the Product Owner, Project managers, system architects and the business partners to understand key objectives and challenges, ensure successful outcomes, and provide the right direction in the dynamic business environment.



Responsibilities



  • Serve as the subject matter expert for solution development in the SAP MDG area
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP MDG solutions for domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance.
  • Lead end-to-end MDG implementations, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support
  • Configure MDG data models, change request types, workflows, business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Integrate SAP MDG with ECC, S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define data governance processes, roles, and policies
  • Support data migration, data cleansing, and data quality initiatives
  • Configure and support BRF+, Workflow (WS-BPEL/Flexible Workflow), DRF, and UI (Fiori/Web Dynpro)
  • Perform configuration of systems and manage transport as part of ITSM, Cloud ALM, and change management across the SAP landscape
  • Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous improvement enhancements
  • Create functional and technical documentation, including design specs, test scripts, and user guides
  • Support user training and knowledge transfer activities to the managed service team.
  • Ensure compliance with data standards, audit requirements, and best practices
  • Perform Functional Unit testing, Product testing, System integration testing, cross functional testing, testing of SAP upgrades, Performance testing, etc.
  • Support UAT, provide user training and support change management and business enablement.
  • Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity.
  • Provides hands-on support to developers (e.g., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code)
  • Other job duties and projects as assigned.


Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data Governance


Required Skills



  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and other SAAS and non-SAP systems.
  • Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle
  • Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF)
  • Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions.
  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions.
  • Provide regular reports on system health and performance.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now.
  • Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates.


Preferred Skills



  • SAP MDG Certification

title: Junior/Pleno Software Engineer (Remoto)
description:
About Wowoo Wowoo is a global consumer technology company building AI-powered mobile applications used by millions of people around the world. Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm, and we are expanding our engineering team in Brazil as part of our long-term commitment to the Latin American tech ecosystem.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and ship product weekly.

The Role We're hiring Software Engineers (Pleno level) to join our distributed engineering team. You'll work on consumer-facing products with millions of active users, ship code that reaches production within days, and collaborate with a senior global team across product, design, and growth.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship features across our mobile and web subscription products
  • Work directly with product managers, designers, and founders in a flat, fast-moving environment
  • Own features end-to-end: from technical design through deployment and post-launch iteration
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and engineering culture as we scale our Brazil team

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong fundamentals in at least one modern stack (TypeScript/Node, Python, Swift, Kotlin, or React)
  • Comfort working in English (written communication is essential; spoken English is a plus)
  • Track record of shipping production code in a fast-paced product environment
  • Self-directed, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity

Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile development (iOS or Android)
  • Background in subscription apps, AI products, or high-scale consumer software
  • Open-source contributions or side projects

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Flexible hours and async-first culture
  • Direct access to founders and meaningful product ownership
  • Annual team offsites

Wowoo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm, and we are expanding our engineering team in Brazil as part of our long-term commitment to the Latin American tech ecosystem.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and ship product weekly.

The Role We're hiring Software Engineers (Pleno level) to join our distributed engineering team. You'll work on consumer-facing products with millions of active users, ship code that reaches production within days, and collaborate with a senior global team across product, design, and growth.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship features across our mobile and web subscription products
  • Work directly with product managers, designers, and founders in a flat, fast-moving environment
  • Own features end-to-end: from technical design through deployment and post-launch iteration
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and engineering culture as we scale our Brazil team

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong fundamentals in at least one modern stack (TypeScript/Node, Python, Swift, Kotlin, or React)
  • Comfort working in English (written communication is essential; spoken English is a plus)
  • Track record of shipping production code in a fast-paced product environment
  • Self-directed, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity

Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile development (iOS or Android)
  • Background in subscription apps, AI products, or high-scale consumer software
  • Open-source contributions or side projects

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Flexible hours and async-first culture
  • Direct access to founders and meaningful product ownership
  • Annual team offsites

Wowoo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Visual Designer - Graphic, Remote
description:
Visual Designer — (Contract / Part-time)


For a visual rich mobile app with natural imagery. We are seeking a designer who can plan and design at the same time, while owning media (pictures, UI, other artworks) to a consistent premium style.


What you’ll do

  • Lead the overall creative direction across brand, product, and user-facing experiences.
  • Curate a consistent image/video library
  • Define presentation patterns (cards, overlays, visuals).
  • Edit assets (color correction, cleanup, crops/ratios, background variants) and export optimized outputs for mobile.
  • Ensure consistency in taste, tone, quality, and emotional appeal across all creative outputs.
  • Design key visuals/ screens (gallery/grid, detail, collections, rewards).
  • Own the overall visual direction and aesthetic quality of the product and brand.


Engagement

Contract, remote-friendly (Global). Flexible schedule. Part-time possible.


Must-have

  • Image editing/retouching (Photoshop/Lightroom or equivalent) with consistent outputs at scale.
  • Graphic design skills
  • Systems mindset: style guides, naming conventions, templates, and content standards.
  • Premium visual taste; excellence


Nice-to-have

  • Experience with content-heavy apps (media galleries, digital apps, UI, motion specs).


How to apply

Apply with: (1) portfolio link (Behance/Dribbble/Figma/website)

We’re building a visual, content-rich mobile app with aesthetic imagery & experiences. We need a designer who can own mobile layouting and curate + edit media to a consistent premium style.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

What You’ll Do Everyday:

- Design and develop the code driven interfaces between our data platform and a variety of internal and external services.

- Take projects from initial requirements gathering through to production deployment and proactive monitoring.

- Build scalable transformations in dbt.

- Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and long term maintainability.

- Leverage AI assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude) to increase development velocity and deliver high-quality solutions faster.

- Partner with Engineering, Product and Analytics teams to solve complex but interesting data challenges.

Skills/Experience - Minimum Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design.

- This is a coding heavy role. You must be able to write production-grade, modular Python code.

- Expert level proficiency in SQL, complex data modeling and BigQuery performance optimization.

- Deep experience with the Data stack of Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow etc) is required.

- Proven success building integrations with API clients to fetch or send data and streaming platforms.

- Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing and project organization).

- Active experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality.

- Expert command of Git, CI/CD workflows and Docker/Kubernetes.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


Desired Skills - Preferred Requirements

- Knowledge of or familiarity with data design patterns like Medallion.

- Experience with Terraform/Atlantis.



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Junior Data Analyst - Remote, Brazil (New Graduates Welcome) Wowoo · Full-time · 100% Remote
description:
About Wowoo Wowoo is a global consumer technology company building AI-powered mobile applications used by millions of people around the world. Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm. As part of our expansion in Latin America, we're opening entry-level positions for talented new graduates and early-career professionals in Brazil.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and invest heavily in the growth of our junior team members.

The Role We're hiring a Junior Data Analyst to join our growth and product analytics team. This is an entry-level role designed for recent graduates or early-career analysts who want to learn from a senior global team and work on real, high-impact business problems from day one.

You'll help us understand how millions of users discover, subscribe to, and engage with our products, and your analysis will directly influence product and marketing decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Build dashboards and reports in BigQuery, Looker, and Metabase to track product, marketing, and revenue metrics
  • Analyze user behavior, subscription funnels, and marketing campaign performance
  • Partner with product managers, marketers, and engineers to answer business questions with data
  • Document findings clearly and present insights to a global team
  • Learn modern data stack tools and grow into a senior analyst over time

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree (completed or in final year) in a quantitative or analytical field: Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or similar
  • Solid SQL fundamentals (we'll test this) or strong willingness to master SQL within the first weeks
  • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic data manipulation
  • Strong written English; comfortable communicating findings clearly in writing
  • Curious, analytical mindset and attention to detail
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Internship experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, or consulting
  • Familiarity with Python, R, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, or Metabase
  • Coursework or projects in statistics, A/B testing, or experimentation
  • Interest in consumer apps, subscription business models, or growth marketing

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation, well above local market for entry-level roles
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Direct mentorship from senior analysts and founders
  • Real ownership and visibility from day one - no coffee runs, no busywork
  • Flexible hours and async-first culture
  • Clear growth path to Mid-level Analyst within 18-24 months
  • Learning budget for courses, books, and conferences

Who Should Apply If you just graduated or are graduating soon, this is for you. If you've been doing internships and want your first full-time role at an international company, this is for you. If you're switching careers from a non-technical background but have strong analytical skills and SQL chops, we want to hear from you.

We don't care which university you attended. We care about how you think.

  • Wowoo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for two skilled Full Stack Developers to work across multiple applications, including signage, clubs, and premium services platforms. The ideal candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, addressing vulnerabilities, and contributing to scalable, secure solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain full stack applications across multiple platforms.
  • Work on signage, clubs, and premium services applications.
  • Identify and resolve system vulnerabilities and ensure application security.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to AWS-based solutions.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong experience in Full Stack Development with Angular and .NET / .NET Core .
  • Open to candidates stronger in either Angular (Frontend) or .NET (Backend) .
  • Hands-on experience with the latest versions of .NET, .NET Core, and Angular .
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases and JSON-based document structures.
  • Exposure to DynamoDB or DocumentDB is preferred.
  • Solid understanding of AWS architecture and services .
  • Experience with AWS AppSync is a plus.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and fix security vulnerabilities.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Full Stack Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Advanced or fluent English is mandatory;
  • The professional must be comfortable participating in daily meetings, technical discussions, and written communication in English;
  • Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript;
  • Experience building modern web applications with reusable component-based architectures;
  • Experience with styling solutions in React, preferably styled-components;
  • Strong experience with Node.js and Next.js API routes for backend-for-frontend or API integration layers;
  • Experience integrating with external APIs and working with API gateway/proxy solutions such as Apigee or AWS API Gateway;
  • Experience with AWS cloud services, especially serverless solutions such as Lambda;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows, preferably with Jenkins;
  • Experience working with Git in collaborative development environments;
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools, preferably New Relic;
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Vitest, Mocha, or React Testing Library;
  • Experience working with Jira and Confluence;

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience with Content Management Systems (e.g. Content Stack, Drupal, Payload CMS);
  • Experience integrating or developing AI-enabled solutions;
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS;
  • Experience with Figma and collaboration with design teams using prototypes;
  • Experience with database services such as PostgreSQL and Databricks;
  • Experience with performance optimization, production support, and troubleshooting in cloud environments;

Responsabilities:

We are looking for a Full Stack Expert developer, self-driven, and self-learning professional to support critical automation initiatives within the Defense Center, with a strong focus on incident automation, workflow orchestration, and Jira backend enablement.

This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and process thinking. The individual must be able to design and implement automation end-to-end, translating complex operational needs into scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve response efficiency.

Given the nature of the work — highly integrated, security‑sensitive, and operationally critical — we need someone who can operate with high autonomy, quickly learn the environment, and continuously evolve the solution without heavy supervision or external dependency.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Type: 12 Month Contract

Location: Fully Remote in Central and South America

Rate: $16/hr USD - $22/hr USD




Job Description


Insight Global is seeking an intermediate QA Analyst to support quality assurance and testing across AI‑enabled insurance workflows at a commercial insurance company based out of Canada. This role will focus on validating AI outputs, ensuring integration reliability, and protecting the platform from regressions as AI models and workflows evolve. Day‑to‑day responsibilities include performing manual testing, identifying test cases suitable for automation, contributing to automated regression test suites, and supporting user acceptance testing with business stakeholders. This resource will work closely with a senior QA team member to expand existing automation frameworks and ensure model changes or upgrades do not negatively impact production workflows. We are seeking an international resource based in LATAM to work closely with a team in Canada on mountain standard time. This is a fully remote 12 month engagement.


Required Skills & Experience


• Minimum 3 years of QA experience

• Strong hand-on manual testing experience

• At least 1 year of automation testing experience

• Experience with Playwright or Selenium

• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions

• Experience supporting UAT (User Acceptance Testing)

• Experience working in Agile delivery teams

• Fluent in English


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Understanding of regression testing strategies

Experience testing REST APIs

Day‑to‑day responsibilities include performing manual testing, identifying test cases suitable for automation, contributing to automated regression test suites, and supporting user acceptance testing with business stakeholders. This resource will work closely with a senior QA team member to expand existing automation frameworks and ensure model changes or upgrades do not negatively impact production workflows. We are seeking an international resource based in LATAM to work closely with a team in Canada on mountain standard time. This is a fully remote 12 month engagement.


Required Skills & Experience


• Minimum 3 years of QA experience

• Strong hand-on manual testing experience

• At least 1 year of automation testing experience

• Experience with Playwright or Selenium

• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions

• Experience supporting UAT (User Acceptance Testing)

• Experience working in Agile delivery teams

• Fluent in English


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Understanding of regression testing strategies

Experience testing REST APIs

title: Executivo Comercial / Belém - PA
description:
Temos vaga no Grupo AG Capital!


Nosso time está crescendo e você pode fazer parte dele e ser um AGente da Transformação!


Ao fazer parte do nosso time, sua missão será atrair e encantar novos clientes para que estes realizem procedimentos de restituição de tributos, compliance tributário e com isso gerem receita para o Grupo AG Capital.

Terá como responsabilidade representar a Casa AG na região, atuando com prospecção, gestão com o funil de vendas junto aos parceiros e apoiar nas demandas operacionais.


Buscamos por pessoas engajadas, focadas e determinadas em ir além.


Acha que faz sentido para você? Então aproveita esta oportunidade e se candidata!


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Apoiar como responsável o funil de vendas da carteira de parceiros e fomento de novos negócios através de clientes indicados;
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais e suporte em vendas, em atuação direta em negociações comerciais e operacionais;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos produtivos com parceiros novos e existentes, bem como com parceiros estratégicos;
  • Prospectar e conquistar novos clientes;
  • Utilizar o CRM como ferramenta central de controle da sua carteira, seguindo o padrão e melhores práticas definidas pela gestão;
  • Buscar conhecimento técnico e atualização constante sobre o mercado tributário;
  • Participar das capacitações promovidas pela empresa e ser protagonista do próprio desenvolvimento;

  • Mapear oportunidades para atingir resultados pré-estabelecidos.

title: Assistente Financeiro - Fiscal Júnior
description:
Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países.


Fazemos parte da NTTDATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DA-TA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países.


Make this the place where you grow!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Aplicação para atuar no time de Customer Success, com foco na análise de documentos fiscais, suporte funcional ao cliente e evolução contínua da nossa plataforma.


Essa posição é ideal para quem tem base em Contabilidade e deseja atuar em um ambiente tecnológico, colaborativo e orientado à experiência do cliente.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Analisar, validar e processar Notas Fiscais, boletos e faturas na plataforma Guepardo APP Cloud;
  • Atuar no suporte funcional ao cliente, esclarecendo dúvidas e orientando sobre o uso correto da plataforma;
  • Configurar e manter regras automáticas de leitura de documentos, utilizando Expressões Regulares (Regex);
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos de Customer Success, contribuindo para uma experiência mais eficiente e fluida para os clientes;
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com o time, garantindo qualidade, organização e confiabilidade das informações fiscais.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis / Contabilidade;
  • Conhecimento prático em documentos fiscais, com capacidade de leitura, entendimento e validação de Notas Fiscais;
  • Comunicação assertiva verbal e escrita;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e atento aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com sistemas e processos;


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento em Expressões Regulares (Regex);
  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Suporte ao Cliente, Implantação ou áreas operacionais de sistemas;
  • Vivência em ambientes SaaS ou tecnologia.


Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT


Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote (UGC, Beauty/Skincare)
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

title: Senior Data & AI Operations Administrator
description:
Jobbex , a company that empowers people & organizations by matching great talents to great projects is looking for the next Senior Data & AI Operations Administrator to support one of our clients.


If you feel inspired to make a change and if you want to be part of the cool kid on the block, this opportunity is for you!


Be ready to find at Jobbex Portugal the transparent, friendly, and professional work environment you have been looking for.



Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily operations of the enterprise data, automation, and AI platform
  • Monitor platform health across data pipelines, automation workflows, and AI services
  • Manage Lakehouse platform operations, configuration, and performance optimization
  • Ensure reliable orchestration and execution of data pipelines and scheduled jobs
  • Support automation workflows and AI-driven processes in production environments
  • Lead deployment and release processes, ensuring smooth platform updates
  • Define and enforce operational standards, monitoring practices, and governance policies
  • Handle incidents, service requests, and escalations across the platform
  • Maintain and improve platform documentation and operational procedures
  • Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to ensure scalable and secure solutions
  • Drive continuous improvement in monitoring, automation, and operational resilience
  • Participate in proof-of-concept initiatives for new data, automation, and AI technologies



Requirements:

  • At least 5 years in data operations, data engineering operations, or analytics platform management
  • Strong experience with Lakehouse or modern cloud data architectures
  • Solid experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure
  • Experience with automation platforms and workflow orchestration
  • Deep understanding of data pipelines, orchestration, and transformation processes



Enthusiastic?

Apply and lets talk.

description:

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
Tulfa is an American multinational company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, specializing in eCommerce solutions for brands, retailers, and manufacturers. We are recognized as one of the top four companies in the eCommerce sector, with operations across the Americas, Europe, Australia, and Asia. Our expertise includes metaverse content production, product imagery, 3D modeling, enhanced brand content, and catalog management. With offices strategically located across five continents, we ensure fast and high-quality delivery. Our team is composed of specialists with extensive hands-on experience in retail, eCommerce, and technology.


Job Description

We are looking for a Motion Graphics Designer to join our team. This professional will be responsible for creating animations, motion graphics, and engaging visual content that enhances our clients’ experience. Daily tasks include collaborating with creative teams, editing videos, developing animated graphic elements, and finalizing design projects. This is a full-time position with remote work flexibility.


Qualifications

  • Motion Design: Experience in animation design, motion graphics creation, and video production, ensuring a high level of visual quality and finishing.
  • Graphic Design: Strong graphic design skills, with a focus on creating impactful visuals aligned with project needs.
  • Tools & Software: Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and Illustrator.
  • Additional Skills: Detail-oriented, creative, and able to manage deadlines and multiple projects simultaneously.
  • 3D Skills: Ability to work with 3D frames; knowledge of 3D is a plus.
  • FX Skills: Basic FX (effects) skills.
  • AI Skills: Experience using AI tools for creative production, with a preference for prompt creation in Higgsfield.
  • Language: Fluent English.
  • Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing relevant work and examples is required


Personal Requirements

  • Strong organizational skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Good communication skills
  • Strong sense of deadlines and time management

title: English Language Teaching (ELT) Materials Editor (Remote | Full-time)
description:
Role Description

This is a remote position for a full-time English Language Teaching (ELT) Materials Editor. The primary responsibilities include developing and editing ELT materials, aligning content with curriculum goals, and ensuring the materials meet high-quality standards. The role involves lesson planning, reviewing instructional design, and collaborating with educators to refine content for various language-learning levels.


Qualifications

  • Expertise in Lesson Planning and Curriculum Development to create effective and engaging learning materials
  • Strong skills in Education and Teaching with a focus on English language instruction
  • Excellent Communication skills to collaborate with team members, educators, and stakeholders
  • Attention to detail, with the ability to perform thorough reviews and quality checks on instructional materials
  • Familiarity with current trends in ELT methodologies and instructional design
  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, English, Linguistics, or a related field; advanced degrees are a plus
  • Experience working with remote teams or creating materials for digital learning platforms is an advantage

title: Freelance Video Editor
description:
Hi from Snov.io , the product company of Ukrainian origin

At Snov.io, we believe in fostering a supportive and collaborative environment where each team member can reach their full potential and contribute to the success of the company

Right now, we’re searching for a skilled Video Editor(Freelance) to join our team. If you're passionate about creating engaging video content, experimenting with styles, and improving visual storytelling, this is your chance to make a difference in a dynamic environment.

As a Video Editor, you'll help bring our ideas to life through high-quality video content for YouTube and other formats.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Editing short and long-form videos (screencasts, explainers, ads, talking-head videos) for YouTube
  • Adding sound effects, music, graphics, and visual effects
  • Creating visual elements using Canva and Adobe After Effects (or Figma)
  • Experimenting with styles and editing techniques
  • Suggesting ideas to improve the quality of video content


Desired Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience as a video editor
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or Vegas, preferably Adobe tools)
  • Basic knowledge of Adobe After Effects
  • Responsibility and ability to meet deadlines
  • Creativity, willingness to experiment, learn, and improve
  • English level: B1


We Offer:

  • Fair compensation that meets your expectations
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunities for growth and development
  • Autonomy and trust—no time trackers, we’re focused on results!
  • Paid sick leave
  • Time to recharge: 20 paid vacation days per year
  • We’re not just coworkers, we’re a team that stands by each other


✅ Our hiring process:

We send a follow-up message (if needed) > invite you for a chat with the recruiter > team reviews your CV/portfolio > test assignment > team interview > reference check > we make an offer.


At Snov.io, you’ll find more than just a job—you’ll find a team that supports you, room to grow, and the freedom to be yourself.

Because yes—we believe it is possible to love what you do.

Come join the ride!

description:
Buscamos profissional especializado em gestão e crescimento de contas em marketplaces, com foco em performance comercial, rentabilidade, escalabilidade das operações e manutenção da saúde das contas, garantindo reputação positiva e indicadores de excelência como Mercado Líder/Platinum.


Experiência em criação, gestão e otimização de campanhas de mídia paga (Mercado Ads, Amazon Ads e Shopee Ads), com foco em melhoria de ACOS, ROAS e conversão. Forte atuação em inteligência comercial, análise de concorrência, definição de preços estratégicos considerando taxas, impostos e margens, além da identificação de oportunidades de mercado.

Conhecimento em integração operacional via ERP e hubs como Bling, Tiny, Anymarket e Plugg.to, garantindo sincronização de estoque, pedidos, preços e faturamento.


Experiência em logística para marketplaces, incluindo gestão de modalidades Full, Flex, coleta e agências, controle de estoque em CDs e planejamento de reabastecimento.


Perfil analítico, proativo, organizado e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de gerir múltiplos canais simultaneamente e resolver problemas com autonomia.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: \"Salesforce Analyst #997821\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender uma das maiores empresas globais do setor de energia, com forte atuação em inovação, tecnologia e transformação digital. O profissional atuará em iniciativas estratégicas voltadas para marketing digital, automação e experiência do cliente , em um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Ser referência técnica de Salesforce dentro das equipes.
  • Desenvolver e integrar soluções em Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Pardot (Account Engagement), Commerce Cloud e Experience Cloud .
  • Apoiar metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe ) na execução dos projetos.
  • Criar e consumir APIs para integração com Salesforce e Azure .
  • Gerenciar versionamento de código com GitHub e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions ).
  • Produzir documentação técnica clara.
  • Coletar requisitos com stakeholders e validar entregáveis.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Vivência com Journey Builder e Automation Studio
  • Conhecimento em SQL e AMPscript

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
We’re looking for five full-time Virtual Assistants based in Brazil to join our global property management and real estate rental operations team. This is a fast-paced, service-driven role where you’ll communicate directly with guests and tenants across multiple properties, ensuring every experience meets our standard of excellence.


If you’re fluent in English, tech-savvy, and passionate about delivering outstanding customer service — this is a great opportunity to grow in an international environment.


⸻


Key Responsibilities


• Craft clear, professional, and empathetic English responses to guest messages, emails, and inquiries across Airbnb, VRBO and other internal platforms.

• Maintain a 5 minute response time to all messages during your shift.

• Deescalate and resolve guest complaints with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.

• Coordinate with cleaning, maintenance, and operations teams to fulfill requests.

• Update and monitor internal systems, CRMs, and property dashboards.

• Document all customer interactions accurately for team follow-up and quality control.

• Collaborate with team members to ensure seamless daily operations.


⸻


Requirements


• Fluent in English (spoken and written) – excellent grammar and communication tone.

• Strong typing skills (80+ WPM) and confidence navigating multiple platforms.

• High attention to detail, accountability, and ability to multitask under pressure.

• Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.

• Must have a reliable laptop/computer and high-speed WiFi.

• Previous experience with Airbnb, property management, or hospitality support is a plus but not required.

• Professional, positive, and culturally aligned with a high standard of service.


⸻


Why Join Us


• Work 100% remotely from anywhere in Brazil.

• Full-time, consistent hours (40 hours/week).

• Competitive hourly rate in USD.

• Supportive, fast-growing international team.

• Career growth opportunities for high-performing team members.


⸻


If you’re ready to join a professional, global team that values reliability, communication, and excellence — we’d love to meet you.

description:

Buscamos Parceiros de Negócios, profissionais seniors, com forte rede de relacionamento com empresários e empresas, e alta capacidade de monetizar seu networking.

Identificamos qualquer tributo pago a maior na Folha de Pagamento, com uso de alta tecnologia.


IDENTIFICAMOS, CALCULAMOS E RECUPERAMOS.

Em 10 dias úteis

Honorários apenas no êxito

Você foca no relacionamento, e 100% do operacional é de nossa responsabilidade

+12.000 clientes satisfeitos

+R$ 8 bilhões recuperados em tributos

14% dos clientes listados na B3


ATIVIDADES


Indicar oportunidades em empresas com + 50 CLTs, com regime tributário no Lucro Real ou Presumido

Apresentar a AG e apoiar reuniões iniciais

Ampliar sua rede de contatos e acrescentar o seu portfólio de serviços e soluções

Atuar em vendas consultivas com suporte técnico e comercial completo


QUEM BUSCAMOS


Profissionais com perfil comercial e consultivo

Boa capacidade de comunicação, articulação e influência

Networking com empresários, executivos, decisores ou gestores

Experiência com vendas, consultoria ou relacionamento B2B

Profissionais como contador, advogado, consultor empresarial e profissionais de RH possuem grande sucesso com a nossa parceria


COMO FUNCIONA A PARCERIA


Contrato de Parceria Comercial (sem custos ou investimentos)

Remuneração arrojada / acima do mercado (100% remuneração variável)

Sem teto ou limites de comissões

Suporte completo: tecnologia, equipe técnica e equipe comercial

Treinamentos, trilhas de formação e acompanhamento

Início imediato
